title: The First Passenger Elevator: This Day in Otis History
lineage: Otis corporate history claims the Haughwout passenger elevator entered service on 23 March 1857. HABS, citing Otis ledger notes, assigns 23 March to shipment and 6 April to completion of installation; sources differ and do not establish a single service date.
